question: What is the meaning of packaging information in relation to supply chain traceability, suppliers’ information, logistics?
data_group: supply chain traceability, suppliers’ information, logistics
description: Packaging information is crucial for supply chain traceability as it contains details about the product, its origin, and handling instructions. This information helps suppliers track and manage their materials efficiently. Additionally, packaging data aids in logistics by providing necessary information for transportation and storage, ensuring smooth and organized supply chain operations.

3.2.1. Product Circularity Data Sheet (PCDS)
In order to address barriers and opportunities identiﬁed during the consultation
process, the PCDS was co-created between the Ministry of the Economy, PositiveIm-
paKT, and more than 50 manufacturers, data aggregation platforms and standards bodies.
According to the report to the Ministry,
“To enable efﬁcient and secure exchange of product circularity information along
the value chain, standardization of the data and format is needed, including an
auditing process” [54].
